name: baby-red-slime-class-bonus-on-attack-discard-fire-power
notes:
Baby Red Slime (r7oifozaog, ALLY): "[Class Bonus] On Attack: You may discard a card. If you do, draw a card into your memory. If the discarded card was a fire element card, Baby Red Slime gets +1 POWER until end of turn." This card's ENTIRE ability is this one Class Bonus On Attack trigger (onAttackAbilities['r7oifozaog:0'] -> customDQHandlers['r7oifozaog:0:OnAttack-1'], GeneratedCode/GeneratedMacroCode.php): gated behind IsClassBonusActive($player, ['TAMER']), it offers an MZMAYCHOOSE over the whole hand; discarding moves the card to the graveyard, calls DrawIntoMemory($player, 1), and -- only if CardElement() of the discarded card is FIRE -- tags the attacker with its own CardID as a TurnEffects marker, which GameLogic.php's power-computation switch (~13504) reads for +1 POWER.

The champion's CardID is patched directly to Silvie, With the Pack (TAMER) for the Class Bonus. Baby Red Slime is seeded directly onto the field -- fine for proving its OWN On Attack trigger, a different trigger than Enter. Red Slime (mttsvbgl6f, FIRE) is seeded into hand purely as discard fodder for the fire sub-clause.

CombatLogic.php's BeginCombatPhase() enforces 'only the player who took the opening turn can't attack on turn 1' (~1441-1447), so the attacker had to be player 2 (not player 1, the first player) -- player 1 passes their own turn 1 first, same shape as samaritan-reach-attacking-ally-damage, reaching player 2's turn where Baby Red Slime can legally declare a real attack via FSM against player 1's champion, genuinely dispatching the On Attack trigger.

Verified live: Red Slime lands in player 2's myGraveyard-0, Baby Red Slime's TurnEffects becomes ['r7oifozaog'], and computed power goes from the printed 2 to 3. Break/restore verified: temporarily short-circuiting the closure's `if($isFire) AddTurnEffect(...)` line to `if (false && $isFire) ...` (GeneratedCode/GeneratedMacroCode.php) made the fixture fail with "Expected myField-1.TurnEffects to equal '[\"r7oifozaog\"]', got '[]'"; restoring the line made it pass again.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Attack: You may discard a card. If you do, draw a card into your memory. If the discarded card was a fire element card, Baby Red Slime gets +1 POWER until end of turn.
